name: SAEe 2026 - 51st Simposio of the Spanish Economic Association
edition: 51st Simposio de la Asociación Española de Economía
organizer: Spanish Economic Association (Asociación Española de Economía, SEA); hosted by Universidad de Las Palmas de Gran Canaria
venue: Faculty of Economics, Business and Tourism (FEET-ULPGC), Campus de Tafira, Universidad de Las Palmas de Gran Canaria
conf_dates_note: Sessions start Wed 16 Dec at 9:00 and end around 15:30 on Fri 18 Dec (Canary Islands time, WET)
submission_requirements: Single PDF of an unpublished paper in English via Congress Creator (select SAEE 2026); max. one paper presented per participant; PhD students must include proof of student status
registration_fee: Reduced rate until 28 Sep 2026: SEA members EUR 250 / non-members EUR 350 (incl. 2026 membership) / students EUR 175. Regular rate after 28 Sep 2026: EUR 400 / EUR 480 / EUR 275
membership_required: Non-student participants must be SEA members or pay the non-member fee, which includes 2026 membership; students get one year of free membership on registration
keynotes: Elena Manresa (Princeton); José Víctor Ríos-Rull (Penn); Isaac Baley (UPF, CREI and BSE); Presidential Address: Pedro Mira (CEMFI)
